test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. S's exam is immediately before R. Only three people have exams between U and Q. Q's exam is immediately before S. Only two people have exams between S and V. P's exam is on Tuesday. R's exam is on Sunday. Who among the following has exam on Monday?
solution:
**Given: **

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. 

**solution:**

(1) P's exam is on Tuesday. 

(2) R's exam is on Sunday. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8d75d9572af32fd271444bce7028c32516c48de6228189833aa3ebb525b442.png] 

(3) S's exam is immediately before R.

(4) Q's exam is immediately before S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/730b582a838619b348dca0ac6532305e25811f1b0d1e3759b93dde3e9c0d4ee4.png] 

(5) Only two people have exams between S and V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dc385092e0044a3800ba92adf04b01b8d495c84057c4ef47f524948c64f59c8.png] 

(6) Only three people have exams between U and Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f3777da8a1fc4089e7e830486a0535c513f18cc70b4c33a037f4f22599cb243.png] 

(7) Now, T has exam on Thursday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ef692ed64c944f930a8f3f2ca705accebcb73ed0dcae957fe0a6774c470da8a.png] 

**Hence, 'U' has exam on Monday.**
